_readme: Machine-readable constants for the @OpenThrottleAI '0-60' video format. This file is the single source of truth consumed by the screencast runner, the narration stage and the ffmpeg assembly stage. Prose rationale lives in docs/marketing/youtube-format.md — change both together.

audio._truePeakNote: -1.0 dBTP, not -1.5. At -1.5 the peak ceiling BINDS before the loudness target is reached: a measured narration take normalised to -15.3 LUFS instead of -14 because raising it further would have breached the peak. -1.0 is a standard safe delivery ceiling and lets the take land at -14.3.

title._note: Shorts have no leading title card — the payoff is on screen at t=0. Long-form uses a 2s title card; see youtube-format.md.

recording._note: Capture is a CDP screencast resampled to a constant fps, not Playwright recordVideo (which is locked to 25fps VP8). See docs/marketing/pipeline.md and the task-3 spike verdict.

portrait._note: Fractions of frame height/width kept clear of meaningful content. The Shorts player overlays the bottom band with title, channel and action rail.
